title.en: MALACÄÑANG PMS LIBRARY BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DECLARING A CERTAIN PARCEL OF LAND OWNED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS LOCATED IN SAN VICENTE, BULAN, SORSOGON AS SOCIALIZED HOUSING SITE AND PROVIDING FOR ITS DISPOSITION TO BONAFIDE OCCUPANTS

text.en:
The parcel of land owned by the Department of Public Works and
Highways located in San Vicente, Bulan, Sorsogon identified as Lot No. 3, Psu-76906,
covered under TCT No. T-7218, with an area of 134,660 square meters, more or less and
occupied by approximately 700 underprivileged families, is hereby declared as socialized
housing site.

The Housing and Urban Development Coordinating Council, as the lead
agency and the Department of Public Works and Highways, Municipal Government of
Bulan, Sorsogon, and Presidential Commission for the Urban Poor shall facilitate the
disposition of said parcels of land to actual occupants upon determination of the just
value of the land and adoption of a rationalized and cost-recoverable scheme.

In the event any provision hereof is declared invalid by any competent
court or tribunal, the other provisions hereof unaffected thereby shall remain in full force

This Order shall take effect immediately.
POMA Outgoing * 10153

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of
the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.
Done in the City of Manila, this IST day of April, in the year of Our Lord,
two thousand and two.
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
